purpose: Preserve UberBond's long-horizon product dream, named program lineage, portfolio breadth, strategic ladders, contradictions and unresolved owner-recalled names across chat/model/context resets without promoting historical or synthetic material into current truth.
truthRule: Current repository code, exact-head executable receipts, and durable external provider/customer evidence outrank this historical memory index. This index prevents forgetting; it does not manufacture present-tense capability, demand, payment, acceptance, legality, provider state, market superiority, or unattended-operation proof.

finalGoal.economicNorthStar: Maximize risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute.
finalGoal.endState: A private, cloud-runnable, globally distributed, evidence-first economic operating system that can lawfully discover opportunities, compose offers, acquire world-class distribution, execute bounded work, reconcile payment, prove delivery and acceptance, renew and expand, learn from verified outcomes, acquire missing capabilities, and increasingly operate without founder attention anywhere the required providers and law permit.
finalGoal.portfolioLaw: Many front-end offers and experiments may exist, potentially hundreds across historical research, but they compose from one shared governed operating system rather than disconnected businesses or duplicate SaaS clones.
finalGoal.distributionGoal: World-class multi-channel distribution using partners and white-label, governed direct outbound, referrals, product-led diagnostics, owned content, SEO/AEO, social/public distribution, communities/directories, marketplaces and agent/API surfaces, with paid media only after budget authority and measured positive economics.
finalGoal.cloudGoal: Run from durable cloud infrastructure with restart-safe scheduling, receipts, provider adapters, health, recovery, auditability, portable repository context and founder-absence evidence rather than dependence on one chat, model, laptop or device.
finalGoal.wealthGoalBoundary: Massive wealth is an ambition, not a repository fact or forecast. Progress is earned through real cleared contribution, accepted delivery, recurrence, partner leverage, defensible learning and founder-light operation.

antiForgettingRules: A chat reset is never a project reset.
Repository canon and current receipts outrank chat recollection.
Do not ask the owner to retell UberBond when repository or retained-file history can recover it.
Never reduce UberBond to the latest active offer; preserve the wider portfolio with explicit states.
Preserve killed frozen superseded partner-gated authority-gated and unresolved ideas rather than silently deleting them.
Historical counts remain historical and never become commercial proof.
A ChatGPT share URL is a pointer, not durable memory; inaccessible content must not be inferred.
Critical named initiatives must not silently disappear from the memory index.
Every material session must leave a durable handoff or canonical receipt.
Current code and external receipts supersede stale memory labels.
Unknown and not-observed are not zero.
lite/ remains protected unless separately justified.
